name: Karasawa Yuuta
source:
2nd year university student. Dining Hall Server.

A womanizing narcissist, he's been like that every since he used to be an upperclassman of the protagonist in high school.
He's always asking the protagonist out on dates whenever he has the chance, his approach isn't lacking, but he rarely gets taken up on the offers.
